name: Grim Cloth Armor display 164511 reaches the client with a cloth chest inventory icon (#13282)
contract: Grim Cloth Armor 2080866 (Cloth Chest, InventoryType=5) is the only item in Item.dbc using display 164511,
whose ItemDisplayInfo.dbc row has an empty InventoryIcon_1 and renders as a '?' icon.
Sibling ItemDisplayInfo rows with Robe_C_03RedBlack_Chest_TU and no pants (6075, 8377, 16572, 147301, 149097, 149200)
and sibling chest display 148983 with Robe_C_02Black_Sleeve_AU/AL use INV_Shirt_07.
The login stream sends display 164511 as SMSG_PATCH_ITEM_DISPLAY_INFO (opcode 2411) with INV_Shirt_07.
Expected before: the stream has no row 164511.
Socketless packet construction does not establish that the client replaces its existing row or renders the icon.
